mDL credential provisioning vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Digital ID capability in Wallet covers storefront language. mDL issuance, Wallet frameworks, and Connect actually separate credential behavior from product-page copy:

  • State DMV & mDL issuance — enrolling a driver's license or state ID with a participating state authority, identity proofing, and credential binding. Controls whether users hold a government ID in Wallet — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • ISO 18013-5 & Wallet.framework identity APIs — presenting mDL credentials, selective disclosure, and reader interactions at TSA or age gates in SwiftUI or UIKit. Listing copy may mention Digital ID frames; building credential APIs is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Apple Wallet card stack — digital wallet home screen, boarding passes, loyalty cards, transit cards, and campus student ID cards. Separate buyer story from government Digital ID credentials — see Apple Wallet listing guide.
  • Apple Pay checkout — NFC tap-to-pay and in-app payment sheets at retail checkout. Separate from government ID credential marketing — see Apple Pay listing guide.
  • Apple Cash & Tap to Cash — peer-to-peer money transfers and balance screens under Settings → Wallet & Apple Pay. Not government ID — see Apple Cash listing guide.
  • Tap to Pay on iPhone — merchant contactless acceptance. Covered on our Tap to Pay listing guide — not Digital ID credential marketing.
  • In-app Digital ID labels — runtime strings on credential faces, present-ID sheets, or verification prompts inside Wallet. Listing rewrite does not cover String Catalog entries rendered after install.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Digital ID features in the binary.

Working Digital ID integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. Digital ID–specific listing copy — what translates differently

Digital ID in Wallet listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe government credentials — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Digital ID vs 数字身份证 vs driver's license

US pages use "Digital ID", "Driver's License in Wallet", or "State ID." China storefront copy often uses 数字身份证 for government digital identity credentials and 驾照 or 驾驶证 for driver's license frames. Apple keeps Digital ID and mDL as product terms where appropriate alongside Chinese phrasing on screenshot overlays.

State ID & 州身份证

Non-driver state identification cards stored in Wallet appear on credential screenshots. Chinese buyers expect 州身份证 for state ID frames — distinct from 驾照 for driver's license cards and from 学生证 for campus student ID on the Apple Wallet card-stack guide.

mDL & 移动驾照

Mobile driver's license (mDL) terminology appears on identity-verification and TSA presentation frames. Chinese App Store copy commonly uses 移动驾照 alongside mDL when that matches your English source — describing the credential surface your gallery shows, not ISO 18013-5 engineering we do not deliver.

Present ID & identity verification

US pages use "Present ID", "Verify your identity", or "Show ID at TSA." Chinese App Store copy uses 出示身份证, 身份验证, or 身份证明 when your frames show those flows — not Passwords or Passkeys sign-in vocabulary from a different shop guide.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Digital ID–relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 数字身份证, 驾照, and mDL each signal different intent from generic Wallet or payment keywords.

Does adding a driver's license to Apple Wallet auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Provisioning a Digital ID, driver's license, or state ID credential in Wallet controls runtime behavior inside the binary — it does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Digital ID, driver's license in Wallet, state ID, mDL, present ID, 数字身份证, 驾照, 驾驶证, 州身份证, 移动驾照, and 身份证明 — rewritten from your English originals.

Why do my Digital ID screenshot captions still say Driver's License in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 数字身份证, 驾照, or 州身份证 value.

数字身份证, 驾照, and 州身份证 fit government Digital ID marketing. 学生证 fits campus student ID on the Apple Wallet card-stack guide. 苹果支付 fits checkout sheets on the Apple Pay guide. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
